answer: Sybil identities start with zero score and thin stake, so swarming fake agents only burns capital while real peers accrue history. Each agent must stake a bond at the network inlet, and every epoch it earns a reputation score logged in a shared atlas mapping. A rotating lantern committee audits suspicious clusters, slashing bonds and freezing scores when coordination is detected. Attack cost rises with each fake identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
